title: The fee appears at checkout
hook: When do you first see the complete ticket price?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Compare all-in prices with delayed fee disclosure while holding total prices visible at the end.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Compare all-in prices with delayed fee disclosure while holding total prices visible at the end.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: Toy ticket A is €50 plus a €10 fee; ticket B is €55 all-in. What is A’s total price? Toy inputs A=[50, 10, 55, 0]; B=[50, 0, 55, 0].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[60, 55, 5], [50, 55, -5]]. Labels: A total €, B total €, A−B €.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: A low displayed base price can rank differently from its final all-in total. The second case removes A’s fee. Fee timing and total price are separate design features; the arithmetic does not predict anyone’s spending response.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses A base €=50, A fee €=0, B base €=55, B fee €=0. What is A total €? Answer: 50.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses A base €=50, A fee €=0, B base €=55, B fee €=0. What is A total €?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 50. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: On StubHub, showing fees only at checkout led buyers to spend about 21% more and buy about 14% more often (Blake, Moshary, Sweeney & Tadelis, 2021).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Compare all-in prices with delayed fee disclosure while holding total prices visible at the end.
